title: Graphic Design Specialist (Philippines, Remote)
description:
Mission

We're on a mission to make Raycon the most loved electronics brand in the world, where every product feels joyful, effortless, and personal. We believe tech should empower, not frustrate. We're hiring a Graphic Design Specialist to create high-performing visual content across paid advertising and digital channels that looks great and drives real results. If you're ready to power up your every day, read on.

Growth

Profitable growth with 4+ million customers and international expansion underway.

Location

Remote. 40 hours per week.

Compensation

Competitive base + performance-based pay increases tied to growth and responsibility.

Team

This role reports to our Head of Creative / Marketing team. You'll collaborate closely with paid media, brand, and performance marketing to ensure every creative asset is on-brand and conversion-ready. You'll be a core driver of Raycon's paid social and digital creative output.

Why Now

Raycon is at a major inflection point, transitioning from a high-growth startup to a globally recognized consumer electronics brand. As we scale paid channels and expand internationally, we need a razor-sharp designer who can produce, iterate, and test creative at speed. This is not a supporting role. You'll be shaping what millions of customers see first.

You'd Be a Fit If You Have

• Formal graphic design training and a portfolio that proves you can hit the ground running

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Figma, and similar design tools

• A strong eye for composition, visual hierarchy, and design that converts, not just looks good

• Experience designing paid social creatives for Meta, Google, or AppLovin

• The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and consistently meet tight deadlines

• Detail-orientation and a genuine respect for brand guidelines and creative briefs

• High self-motivation, you don't need to be managed, you manage yourself

• Familiarity with AI tools to generate or augment ad creatives

• Ability to animate statics with AI

• Strong written and verbal English communication

Key Responsibilities

Ad Creative Production

• Design ad creatives, banners, and promotional graphics for paid social and digital channels (Meta, Google, AppLovin, etc.)

• Edit and prepare images for use across ad formats, sizes, and placements

Creative Testing

• Build mockups for A/B creative tests aligned with brand guidelines

• Iterate quickly based on performance data and feedback from the media team

Brand Execution

• Collaborate with the marketing team to maintain brand consistency while bringing fresh, conversion-focused ideas

• Uphold Raycon's visual identity across every deliverable

Project Management

• Own your workload: manage multiple active projects independently, hit deadlines, and flag blockers early

What Success Looks Like

• Ad creatives are delivered on time, on-brand, and ready for launch without revision loops

• A/B test mockups are structured clearly and enable rapid creative iteration

• Visual quality and conversion performance improve over time as you learn the brand

• You become a trusted creative partner the media team relies on

Why Work at Raycon

• Impact: Your work shows up in front of millions of customers. What you design gets seen.

• Autonomy: Own your creative output and build a body of work you're proud of.

• Stability: We invest in great people. Several of our team members have been with us for 4+ years.

Company Values

• Customer First: Follow the customer when in doubt. Customer happiness is the obsession.

• Think Big: Dream big, reject complacency, set the highest standards.

• Raise the Bar Every Day: Don't settle; drive positive change daily for both the brand and personal growth.

• GSD (Get Sh*t Done): Execute with agility and precision. Stay on your toes.

Interview Process

• Initial Application: Submit your application and portfolio

• Case Study: A practical creative exercise tailored to the role

title: Senior International Category Manager - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
Job Description

The Senior Procurement Category Manager is reporting to Associate Director Fresh and will be based either at our office in Penrose, Auckland, New Zealand or at our office in Chippendale, Sydney, Australia. 

In this role you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and executing the strategy for one of our fast-paced categories, our protein category. You will lead complex supplier negotiations, setting strategic direction, and driving both cost efficiency and supply chain resilience. You will be the primary escalation point for operational issues, lead continuous improvement initiatives, and serve as a key cross-functional partner in bringing innovative and sustainable sourcing strategies to life.

You will…

• Own and drive the category strategy, setting multi-year sourcing roadmaps aligned to business objectives.

• Lead market analysis and category reviews to proactively identify risks, opportunities, and competitive advantage.

• Act as the senior point of escalation for category issues, making decisions with confidence and autonomy.

• Lead high-value, complex supplier negotiations with a focus on long-term value creation.

• Build, develop, and manage a high-performing supplier network across New Zealand.

• Establish and maintain robust supplier relationships at a senior level, driving strategic partnerships and collaborative innovation.

• Lead cost reporting, tendering, invoice validation, and compliance activities across the category.

• Lead and influence a diverse range of senior stakeholders across the business.

You have/are …

• 5+ years of strategic procurement, supply chain, or category management experience - ideally within FMCG, food, or consumer goods.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex supplier negotiations and managing high-value supplier relationships.

• Proven track record of developing and executing category strategies that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• Strong analytical capability, including advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large data sets.

• Exceptional communication skills - written and verbal - with demonstrated ability to present to and influence senior leadership.

• Knowledge of and genuine interest in food - produce industry experience highly desirable.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, or equivalent.

• An entrepreneurial mindset: proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity at pace.

• A strategic thinker who can operate at both a high level and dive deep into operational detail when needed.

What you’ll get in return… 

• The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company

• Flexible working arrangements 

• Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth

• Free access to Headspace

• Internal learning & development 

• A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries

• Competitive salary & benefits - 70% off HelloFresh

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Duration: 12 Month Fixed Term Contract. You must have the right to work full-time in Australia and or New Zealand.

Location: Penrose, Auckland (New Zealand) or Chippendale, Sydney (Australia)

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits

title: Scrum Master
description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!  
As a Scrum Master you will be a delivery leader responsible for enabling effective execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement within a value stream or domain-aligned team. This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and IT Portfolio Management to help teams deliver value predictably and sustainably.
Reporting to the Manager of IT Portfolio Operations, the Scrum Master focuses on how work gets done - facilitating team effectiveness, improving flow, surfacing impediments, and fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and transparency. This role goes beyond facilitating ceremonies to actively coach teams and stakeholders in agile and lean practices that fit the complexity of our environment.
What you’ll do
Team Delivery Enablement

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and team-level planning activities in a way that drives clarity, alignment, and outcomes.

• Help teams plan, sequence, and execute work effectively while balancing quality, predictability, and flow.

• Coach teams on backlog readiness, estimation, and commitment practices.

• Support teams in managing dependencies, risks, and impediments, escalating as needed through appropriate channels.

• Encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration within the team.
Flow, Visibility & Metrics

• Promote transparency into delivery progress, risks, and dependencies using agreed tooling and practices (e.g., Azure DevOps).

• Help teams understand and use delivery metrics (e.g., flow, predictability, throughput) to inform continuous improvement.

• Ensure work items are well-maintained and accurately represented to support portfolio-level visibility.

• Partner with IT Portfolio Managers to provide reliable insights into team delivery status and capacity.
Coaching & Continuous Improvement

• Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile and Lean principles and practices.

• Facilitate retrospectives that lead to actionable improvement experiments.

• Help teams evolve from reactive execution to proactive problem-solving and systems thinking.

• Foster a psychologically safe environment that supports learning, experimentation, and honest feedback.
Cross-Team & Ecosystem Collaboration

• Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to align practices and manage cross-team dependencies.

• Partner with Technical Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, and Architects to improve engagement, planning, and delivery outcomes.

• Participate in Communities of Practice to share learnings and promote consistent delivery practices.

• Support organizational initiatives related to delivery maturity and operational excellence.
Standards, Tools & Ways of Working

• Apply and reinforce agreed delivery standards, readiness expectations, and tooling practices.

• Use frameworks pragmatically (Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban) based on team context and maturity.

• Contribute feedback to resources, templates, and guidance to improve their effectiveness and relevance.
Reporting & Role Context

• Reports to the Manager of IT Portfolio Operations

• Supports one or more teams aligned to a value stream or domain

• Partners closely with IT Portfolio Managers, Engineering, Product, and Architecture

• Leverages tools including Azure DevOps

description:
At Coinme , we’re redefining access to financial services in a digital world. By combining the cutting-edge power of blockchain technology with everyday simplicity, we make digital currencies accessible and usable for all.

As the world's largest network of cryptocurrency kiosks with over 40,000 locations nationwide, we're breaking down barriers to crypto adoption through our seamless mobile app, secure digital wallet, and DeFi integrations. Beyond our consumer offerings, we're also the infrastructure powering the crypto revolution for businesses.

Through our enterprise Crypto-as-a-Service (CaaS) platform, we enable businesses to launch crypto capabilities in weeks, not months. Our modular, API-first infrastructure provides everything from KYC and payment processing to liquidity and custody solutions-all fully licensed and compliant.

We’re big enough to lead the charge in decentralized finance but small enough that your ideas will make waves. Every role at Coinme contributes to building a financial future where everyone has the tools to thrive. At Coinme , your growth fuels our mission. Together, we RISE.

About The Dollar Foundation
The Dollar Foundation is the non-profit steward of the Bitcoin Dollar - a DeFi yield platform built on BTCD, a collateralized token holding 50/50 BTC/USD exposure.
BTCD itself isn't the product; it's the foundation. Staking BTCD mints sBTCD, a yield-bearing token that captures returns from the full underlying portfolio - productive BTC (ybBTC), productive dollars (sUSDS, sUSDe etc.), and the portfolio's volatility-monetization engine. That makes sBTCD one of DeFi's most powerful collateral primitives: it earns from both sides of the balance sheet.
Using sBTCD as collateral, the platform builds isolated, structured products on top:

• USD Vault - borrows BTC against sBTCD for 12-19% APY in dollar terms, with zero BTC price risk to the depositor.

• BTC Vault - borrows USD against sBTCD for 6-14% APY denominated in BTC, preserving full Bitcoin exposure.

Depositors simply choose USDC or wBTC; the vaults handle leverage, rebalancing, and risk. Today, that engine drives BTCD TVL. Tomorrow it powers a family of assets - an ETH Dollar, a HYPE Dollar, an XRP Dollar and beyond - each a new productive collateral primitive on the same rails.
The protocol is live, audited, and in market, built by crypto leaders from Coinme , Bullish, ShapeShift, Credora, and ether.fi, and backed by Polygon Labs and Coinme .
Role Overview
We are hiring a founding CEO to own capital formation, TVL growth, and the FISC token economy. This is not a foundation steward role and not a TradFi executive seat. It is a hands-on, commercial, crypto-native operating role for someone who has personally scaled a DeFi protocol, knows tokenomics as a craft, has credibility with curators, funds and risk firms and can champion a vision for the ecosystem online and onstage.
Key Responsibilities

• Own TVL growth across token demand, staking, and vault deposits - and set, track, and report the growth and financial metrics that govern it.

• Lead capital formation end-to-end - raise the Series A from crypto-native investors and secure the seed liquidity and incentive capital needed to bootstrap and retain TVL.

• Own the FISC token economy and capital-markets strategy - tokenomics, emissions, points and incentive programs, liquidity mining, and bribe-market deployment.

• Convert and deepen the curator and risk pipeline - turn warm relationships into live, endorsed integrations. Curator trust is the protocol's #1 conversion unlock.

• Build the capital stack beyond the raise - crypto hedge funds, LPs, and ecosystem partners now; institutional and TradFi allocators as the platform matures.

• Be the public face of Bitcoin Dollar and FISC - conferences, podcasts, Twitter Spaces, and forums - carrying a credible, transparent narrative.

• Drive the trust-infrastructure agenda - real-time Proof of Reserves, DeFiLlama and aggregator listings, public

description:

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada ’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada ’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

The Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between technical expertise and sales acumen. This position requires a blend of technical knowledge and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate the value of complex technical solutions to potential clients. The Customer Engineer collaborates closely with the sales team to understand customer needs, provide technical demonstrations, and offer tailored solutions that address client requirements. This role is instrumental in driving revenue growth by effectively positioning the company's products or services within the marketplace.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

• Provide expert technical guidance to customers and sales peers regarding Armada ’s products and services. Understand client challenges and propose appropriate solutions to meet their needs.

• Lead technical demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and workshops to showcase features, functionalities, and benefits of the company’s offerings. Tailor demonstrations and execute workshops to address specific client challenges.

• Collaborate cross-functional to support sales, including customer engagements, technical scoping, and proposal development. Influence and align internal teams to drive solution strategy, resource prioritization, and successful business outcomes.

• Cultivate strong relationships with key client stakeholders, including technical decision makers and influencers. Serve as a trusted advisor through thought leadership, understanding their challenges, and providing tailored solutions based on technical business needs.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive developments, and emerging technologies. Leverage market awareness to identify opportunities for product innovation and differentiation.

• Enhance field team understanding of technical concepts, product features, and selling strategies. Provide ongoing support and enablement of resources to empower sales representatives in their client interactions.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.

• 5+ years proven experience in pre-sales, sales/customer engineering, or solution architecture role supporting technical products.

• Conceptual understanding of networking and connectivity fundamentals, including IP addressing, firewalls, SD-WAN, and satellite or cellular-based communication systems (e.g., Starlink, LTE/5G).

• Familiarity with cloud platforms, virtualization or containerization technologies, and modern enterprise infrastructure.

title: VP, People
description:
VP, People
Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the CHRO | Remote, US-based
Salary range: $210,000 - $230,000, plus 30% target annual bonus and RSUs
How We Got Here
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.
We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.
Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze . Our platform includes:

•
B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines

•
B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media

•
B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in

•
Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com
The Role
We need a builder to run People at a public, remote-first company scaling through roughly the 500-1000 range while expanding internationally. You'll design the systems that make Backblaze a great place to work when there's no office doing that job for us - engagement, culture, communications, retention, succession, and manager development - and you'll run a small HR Operations and strategic HRBP team to do it.
This isn't a maintenance role. The operational foundation is already in place; you'll build the next layer on top of it, with your team, using AI agents as part of how the work gets done. If your instinct is to scope a vendor and a project plan, or disappear for six weeks and come back with a deck, this isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to open a doc, pull your team in, and start building the first version together, keep reading.
What You Will Own
Build

• Making Backblaze an even better place to work when there is no office carrying it for us. That means designing connection, belonging, and teamwork into how the company operates rather than hoping they happen on their own.

• Engagement as a leader-owned discipline with outcomes, not a survey followed by silence. People want to connect their work to where the company is going. You build the system that makes that real.

• Strategic employee and leader communications: a standing rhythm that gives people line of sight to the strategy, tells the same story every quarter, and makes sure information reaches every geography and every time zone.

• Culture as a design output. We are remote-first, expanding internationally, and growing fast. Connection, recognition, and belonging stop happening by accident at this stage. If we do not design them, distance designs them for us. Onboarding, team rituals, and the few in-person moments a year get designed and budgeted like anything else that matters.

• Remote working excellence: one company, many geographies. Same expectations, same development, same voice in the room, wherever someone sits. Offshore is where we hire, not a tier of employees.

• Retention and succession: knowing who is at risk before they resign, building the bench underneath key roles, and making sure we are not one resignation away from a gap we cannot fill.

• A learning organization: manager capability rebuilt for distr

title: Video Editor – Short-Form & Ad Creative
description:
Video Editor - Short-Form & Ad Creative
Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time | Paid in USD $4.50 - $7.50 USD/hour (approx. ₱48,000 - ₱80,000/month full-time; varies with exchange rate)
Can you take raw footage and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad? Do you know why a viewer drops off at second 3 - and how to re-cut the hook so they don't? If editing is your craft and volume doesn't scare you, keep reading.
We're hiring a Video Editor on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll produce the video creative that powers real ad campaigns - working alongside a team of media buyers and copywriters whose campaigns live or die on the quality of your edits. When your video converts, everyone sees it in the numbers.
This is a production role with real output expectations: a minimum of 30 edited pieces of content per week. If you're fast, consistent, and take pride in clean work at volume, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Do
Editing & Production

• Edit a minimum of 30 pieces of content per week - primarily short-form vertical video (ads, social clips, talking-head content, before/after project footage)

• Cut raw client footage into polished, caption-ready edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and clean audio

• Produce multiple variations of winning ads (new hooks, new CTAs, new openers) for A/B testing

• Format deliverables correctly for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube placements

Collaboration

• Work directly with media buyers to understand which creatives are performing and iterate on winners

• Turn copywriters' scripts and hooks into finished video

• Manage your queue through the team's project management system and hit deadlines without chasing

Organization & Quality

• Maintain organized project files, brand assets, and templates for each client

• Apply client branding consistently (logos, colors, fonts, end cards)

• Self-review every edit before delivery - clean captions, no dead frames, correct aspect ratios

What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience

• Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut - fast enough in your tool of choice to hit 6 finished edits per day

• A portfolio of short-form edits: ads, reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

• Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and retention - you edit for the viewer who's about to scroll away

• Experience creating captions/subtitles and editing for sound-off viewing

• Organized, deadline-driven, and consistent - volume work requires systems, not heroics

• Reliable home office setup with an editing-capable computer and stable, high-speed internet

• Availability for a consistent Monday-Friday full-time schedule with at least 3-4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours for team communication (the rest of your day is flexible)

Nice to Have

• Experience using AI tools in your workflow (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Midjourney, HeyGen, or similar) - we love editors who use AI to go faster without losing quality

• After Effects / motion graphics skills

• Experience editing direct-response ad creative with measurable results

• Experience with home services, construction, or local business content

• Thumbnail or static creative design skills (Canva, Photoshop)

When you apply, include the word FRAMEWORK in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field. This is how we know you read the full post.

What's Included

• $4.50 - $7.50 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. ₱48,000 - ₱80,000/month full-time) - placement in the band depends on speed, skill level, and portfolio, with a formal review at 90 days

• Performance bonuses tied to creative performance and output consistency

• HMO coverage on your terms - after 90 days, choose the HMO plan that fits you (and your family), and we cover it through a monthly healthcare benefit. You pick the provider; we pay for it.

• Fully remote, full-time position

• Growth path into a Senior Editor / Creative Lead

title: Principal Sales Operation Analyst, EMEA
description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

Position Summary

As a Principal Analyst in Sales Operations, you will play a critical, highly independent role in shaping and running sales operations for our EMEA business. You'll partner closely with our Head of EMEA Sales and senior sales leadership, acting as a trusted advisor who can turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports, suited to someone who works well independently, takes ownership without needing much oversight, and has earned the trust of senior stakeholders through sound judgment and strong execution. This role reports to the VP, Sales Operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Sales Strategy & Planning: own territory management and headcount planning for EMEA, continually reassessing and adjusting plans to stay ahead of the business

• Reporting & Analytics: lead business reviews with senior leadership; deliver ad-hoc reporting on pipeline, closed-won trends, productivity, and other key sales metrics

• Sales Process Ownership: own core sales processes - forecasting, pipeline management, and segmentation - and support the sales technology stack

• Cross-Functional Partnership: partner with Customer Ops, Enablement, Sales Compensation, Marketing Ops, Deals Desk, FP&A, and other teams to keep sales operations aligned with the broader business

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Based in the UK or Germany; fluent in English required, additional languages a plus

• 3-5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related analytical role

• Highly independent and self-directed, with the judgment to operate autonomously and the track record to be trusted with sensitive information by senior leadership

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and translate data into clear, actionable insight for both analytical and non-analytical audiences

• Excellent communicator, able to build credibility and trust quickly with senior leaders (including our Head of EMEA) and cross-functional partners

• Experience owning sales forecasting, pipeline management, and segmentation

• Comfortable partnering across functions - Customer Ops, Enablement, Sales Compensation, Marketing Ops, Deals Desk, FP&A, and others - without formal authority over those teams

• Strong expertise with sales automation and CRM platforms

• Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

• Strategic mindset and ability to think analytically, solve complex problems, and drive process improvements

• Familiarity with emerging sales technologies and trends in revenue operations

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
company: Job Application for Head of Engineering, Supply Chain at Moniepoint
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in UK.

About The Role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks - verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors - and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas.

description:

title: Traveling Registered Vascular Technologist
description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease-such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 8 states , and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care-delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93 , the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

About the Role

Metro Vein Centers is seeking a Traveling Vascular Ultrasound Technologist (RVT, RVS, or ARRT) to support multiple clinics within an assigned market cluster.

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced vascular sonographers seeking a consistent Monday-Friday outpatient schedule while working across multiple clinic locations within a collaborative, patient-focused environment. Our Traveling RVTs play a critical role in maintaining strong clinic coverage, supporting physician partners, and ensuring patients receive high-quality vascular ultrasound care throughout the market.

Unlike a traditional single-site RVT role, Traveling RVTs are highly adaptable team members who thrive in dynamic environments and are comfortable supporting different clinic teams, workflows, and patient volumes throughout the week. Schedules are communicated in advance, and float assignments remain within a defined geographic market.

At Metro Vein Centers, our RVTs are a critical extension of our physicians-ensuring every ultrasound scan supports accurate diagnoses, procedural success, and exceptional patient care.

What Your Day Looks Like

• Supporting one clinic location per day within an assigned market cluster

• Average patient volume of approximately 8-10 patients daily

• New patient venous insufficiency studies typically last 45-60 minutes

• Post-op and follow-up scans typically last 20-30 minutes

• Fast-paced outpatient vascular environment with strong physician and team collaboration

• Traveling to different clinic locations throughout the week based on the assigned schedule

• Supporting clinic coverage needs while maintaining high-quality patient care standards

• Consistent weekday schedule with no overnight shifts or weekends

What You’ll Do

• Perform high-quality lower extremity venous duplex ultrasound evaluations and post-treatment scans

• Maintain proper scanning protocols while ensuring patient comfort and safety during exams

• Communicate preliminary findings to physicians accurately and efficiently

• Document ultrasound findings and patient information within the EMR system

• Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards within exam rooms and ultrasound equipment areas

• Support daily patient flow in partnership with physicians, medical assistants, and front desk teams

• Travel between clinics within an assigned geographic market based on operational needs

• Adapt quickly to varying clinic workflows while maintaining strong patient experience standards

• Deliver compassionate, patient-centered care throughout the entire patient experience

What You’ll Bring

• Active RVT (ARDMS), RVS (CCI), or ARRT certification required

• Minimum of one year of hands-on vascular ultrasound scanning experience required

• Strong ultrasound scanning skills and attention to detail

• Passion for patient care and creating a positive patient experience

• Excellent communication and teamwork skills

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced outpatient clinical environment

• Reliable, flexible, and highly adaptable mindset

• Ability and willingness to travel throughout an assigned clinic market

• Completion of an accredited allied health, diagnostic medical sonography, or vascular ultrasound program preferred

Preferred Experience

• Venous insufficiency studies

• Vascular ultrasound or duplex ult

title: テクニカルアカウントマネージャー アーキテクト - 日本
description:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー(「TAM」)アーキテクトは、サポートサービスチームおよびサポートグループのメンバーとして、地域のサポートエンジニアリングマネージャーの配下に置かれる予定です。この新しい役職は、既存チームが一部担っている機能を遂行します。具体的には、コンサルティングサポート、エスカレーション対応の洞察、監督といった機能を、複数の顧客に対して継続的にTAM業務、コンサルティング業務、サポート業務として提供します。TAMアーキテクトはまた、エンタープライズ顧客のサポートケースにL3(サポートレベル3=エスカレーション対応)として対応します。

注:本ポジションは日本での採用となります。東京の顧客に対面でサポートを提供するための出張が発生します。

TAMアーキテクトとして成功するためには、以下の適性とアプローチが求められます:

- 高い技術力を持ち、ユーザー、顧客、見込み客に有用なソリューションを提供することに重点を置いていること

- チームメンバーおよび顧客との優れたコミュニケーション能力

- コンサルティング、サポート、プロジェクトマネジメントのスキルと経験

- 業務の50%は、戦略的ユーザー/顧客/見込み客からのケースベースのコンサルティングサポート

- 業務の50%はTAM業務(プロジェクトガイダンス、オンボーディング調整、エスカレーション対応、コミュニケーション、ドキュメント作成、ロードマップ、会議のリード)

- 現地での出張が一部必要であり、現時点では最大で業務時間の35%程度と想定されています

業務内容:

- ClickHouseセールスが特定した戦略的・エンタープライズのClickHouseユーザー、顧客、見込み客と協力し、オンボーディング、本番環境へのローンチ、POC(概念実証)に取り組む

- アーキテクチャ、技術、移行に関するガイダンスと支援を提供する

- ユーザー/顧客の継続的な成功を実現するため、プロジェクト、エスカレーション、会議をリードする

- L3サポートケースおよびエスカレーションの責任と監督を担い、サポートL1/L2チームと緊密に連携する

- ClickHouseのプロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、セールスと緊密に連携し、ロードマップおよびアカウントプランの策定を支援する

- グローバルかつ分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要なスケジュールおよび出張に対応し、常に対応可能な状態を維持する

- 新しいチームメンバーの採用およびメンタリングを支援する

- ドキュメント、ナレッジベース記事、ClickHouse Learning、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、QA(品質保証)ニーズの開発・支援を行う

求める経験・スキル:

- テクニカルアカウントマネジメント、プロフェッショナルサービス、シニアサポート、および/またはプロジェクトマネジメントの職務における5年以上の経験

- スケーラブルかつフォールトトレラントな分散型データベース管理システム(「DBMS」)の実装、運用、および/またはサポートにおける5年以上の関連業界経験

- DBMS、OLAP、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォーム、分散システムのソフトウェアエンジニアリング、Linux/Unix、Kubernetes、システムまたはネットワーク管理、ビッグデータなど、関連分野における広範かつ深い技術知識

- 複数の経験豊富なエンジニアと連携し、大規模な技術プロジェクトをリードし完遂した経験

- パブリッククラウドプロバイダー(AWS、GCP、Azure)およびそのIaaS(Infrastructure as a Service)サービス(例:EC2)に関する専門知識

- 優れたコミュニケーション能力、および顧客対応の役割においてサポートサービス、エンジニアリング、セールスチームと緊密に協働する能力

- チームワーク、グローバルな関与、共感、そして困難な課題を解決するマインドセット

- 地球上で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能を持ち、最大規模かつ最速のデータベースを構築することへの冒険心と当事者意識

- 自発的で、探究心があり、継続的に学び成長することに意欲的であること

訳語の確認・注記:

- TAM (Technical Account Manager) と L3 (Support Level 3) は業界標準の略称としてそのまま保持しました(日本語の技術業界でもTAM/L1・L2・L3という表記が一般的です)。

- POC は「概念実証」と補足しましたが、業界では英語表記のまま使われることも多いため、必要であれば「POC」のみに戻せます。

- IaaS も同様に、EC2の例と合わせて分かりやすくするため展開して記載しました。

- 会社名「ClickHouse」、サービス名「ClickHouse Learning」は固有名詞としてそのまま英語表記を維持しています。

必要であれば、より簡潔な社内向けトーンや、より厳密な求人サイト向けのフォーマルなトーンに調整することも可能です。

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

title: Senior AI Builder
description:
Senior AI Builder (Agents & Automation)
Full-time · Remote · Fintech / Prop Trading · Dubai-based group
A high-leverage hire: one strong builder delivering the output of an entire team. You own AI across the business - support, content, acquisition, operations - and turn vague business problems into systems that ship and run in production. We expect a lot and resource you accordingly.
You build, we deploy. You report directly to the founder.
What you will own
Support, near-autonomous
An agent on Intercom that reads the full knowledge base and resolves the bulk of tickets end to end, across our markets' languages, escalating the rest with context already gathered.
A content engine
Pipelines that produce, test and iterate ad creatives, landing copy, social and Reddit posts, and generated video, at the output of a full content team.
Data-driven acquisition
Agents that cross WooCommerce and Meta spend, track CPA and ROAS per country in real time, flag what to cut and what to scale, and deliver a decision brief every morning.
Permanent competitive intelligence
Monitoring of other prop firms - pricing, rules, promos, payout changes - with a daily digest.
Custom internal software
With Claude Code, real tools shipped to production - plugins, internal apps, scrapers, dashboards. No dev team required.
Multi-agent orchestration
Systems that plan, delegate to sub-agents, self-correct, and run 24/7 with memory and self-improving skills.
The bar (we hire on proof of production, not demos)

• Daily, advanced use of Claude: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, the API. Chatting with ChatGPT is not a skill.

• You have built, deployed and run AI agents in production, not one-off demos: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, custom builds or equivalent. Setup, memory, monitoring, cost control, uptime.

• You ship real software. You read, write and debug Python and JavaScript and turn an idea into a working tool without waiting on anyone.

• You know the current model landscape and when to use what: Claude Opus 4.8 / Fable 5, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3, open-weight models like Qwen. You follow releases weekly.

• End-to-end automations: n8n, Make or code, APIs, webhooks, scraping, MCP.

• AI image and video generation with the current top models: Nano Banana Pro, FLUX.2, GPT Image 2, Ideogram (image); Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Runway (video).

• You manage what breaks: hallucinations, runaway API costs, edge cases, reliability over time.

• Fluent English.

• A portfolio of real, shipped, running systems. No portfolio, no reply.

What we do not care about

• Diplomas, AI certifications, prompt engineering courses.

• We only look at what you built and what it survived in production.

What you get

• Full tools budget: Claude Max, API credits, whatever your stack needs.

• Real ownership and a direct line to the founder. You decide how things get built.

This role is not for you if

• You have only "used ChatGPT a lot."

• Your war stories are vague.

• Your projects look good in a demo but have never run in production.

• You wait to be told exactly what to do.

• You want a quiet job.

How to apply
To confirm you read this post, start your message with the word AGENT . Applications without it are not read.
Send:

• 2 or 3 systems you built and ran in production: the problem, the stack, the result, and what broke and how you handled it. Links, demos or repos required.

• In a few lines: with your first 30 days here, what AI system would you build first to create measurable business impact in a prop firm?

Process

• Shortlist

• Screen-share call

• Offer

We are an international fintech group operating several prop trading firms across our core markets, headquartered in Dubai and scaling internationally. The business is growing fast, and AI is central to how we operate and scale.

At LendingPoint , we believe that everyone deserves to feel the power of possibilities. As an online fintech company, we’ve created advanced consumer, small business, and merchant point-of-sale lending solutions to unlock access to affordable loans and empower those working to build their financial potential. By creating technology that sees your potential, we’re driving a better lending and borrowing experience by finding more reasons to say “yes.”

More than just a job, LendingPoint is an exciting career choice where you’ll bring your expertise and experience to a talented team focused on fostering positive new customer experiences that inspire loyalty.

Are we speaking about you? Then keep reading.

What’s In It For You?

• Competitive Base Salary

• Excellent Benefits Package That Includes: Medical/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Holidays, and more!

• Team Oriented Fast-Paced Fun Environment

• Dedicated and experienced Management Team

• On-going training and investment in our employees

What You’ll Do Day to Day:

LendingPoint is looking for a Lead Data Scientist who can efficiently lead and evolve our direct mail and email program. This person will build datasets and dashboards to drive analytical insights, develop and implement predictive models for direct mail and email targeting strategies, support planning and execution of this program to meet acquisition goals.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with B2C FinTech models and have the ability to contribute new thinking to position the LendingPoint brand and products to achieve both short and long-term goals. They will have the skill set to manage this channel alongside their counterparts to develop an integrated marketing plan that meets sales and profitability expectations.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Solve business problems by leveraging techniques such as segmentation, optimization, advanced analytics and machine learning

• Create reports and dashboards to closely monitor performance metrics and provide insights

• Automate datasets, production process and reporting to solve for analytical needs

• Create test plans to drive growth in applicants and customers

• Create campaign performance measurement framework

• Execute plans to drive deeper engagement, loyalty and lifetime value

• Collaborate with web and digital marketing peers to enable cross channel campaigns

• Maintain ROI goals, CAC and other performance benchmarks

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative or related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, etc.); Master’s degree preferred

• Minimum of two years’ experience, preferably in integrated marketing or analytics roles

• Experience/knowledge of personal lending, banking or fintech

• Ability to use data and best practices to think critically, problem-solve, and recommend solutions

• Experience with statistical modeling, creative testing and advanced analytics

• Proficient in SQL, Python, etc.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Web Application Services
description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

Our small but growing distributed team includes more than 65 people across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, AI offerings, and enterprise-facing work to build independent, privacy-respecting alternatives to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s applications freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about Thunderbird and Mozilla: Thunderbird Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird email and a growing portfolio of products. While part of the Mozilla family, Thunderbird is a separate entity from Mozilla Corporation and Mozilla Foundation with its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit  www.thunderbird.net

The opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer, Services, you’ll help shape the architecture and technical direction of web-based products that extend Thunderbird beyond email. The Services team is currently focused on building offerings such as an appointment calendar and secure file storage and transfer solutions, creating valuable experiences for our users while supporting additional revenue streams for Thunderbird.

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role with significant technical ownership and influence. You’ll work with designers, engineers, and community members to write code, build prototypes, solve complex problems, and make technical decisions that shape our products. You’ll take a holistic view of our code and systems, helping establish the architecture and software patterns that allow our Services products to evolve and scale.

You’ll also take on broad, ambiguous problems that have a direct impact on our goals, from improving our technical architecture to helping grow Services users and subscribers. Along the way, you’ll provide technical and product direction across teams, mentor other engineers, and identify ways to make our systems and processes more sustainable, scalable, and easier to work with.

What you’ll do 

• Lead the technical architecture of new Services products, taking ownership of complex projects and identifying improvements that strengthen our systems as they evolve.

• Write code, build prototypes and experiments, and contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from planning and testing through implementation, monitoring, and maintenance.

• Help establish software patterns and make technical decisions across our Services products, including investigating and proposing technology choices.

• Build and evolve analytics and infrastructure that help the team use user-generated data to inform decisions.

• Take on ambiguous, high-level problems with broad scope and direct impact on Services goals, including growing users and subscribers.

• Provide technical and product direction across Thunderbird and lead technical collaboration with other parts of Mozilla and community contributors when needed.

• Work closely with the team and community to surface issues, refine ideas, and develop practical solutions.

• Identify and plan improvements that make our systems and processes more accessible, self-serviceable, lower friction, sustainable, scalable, and easier to delegate.

title: Constellation Architecture Design & Simulation Engineer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 
E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.
 
By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system-with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices-we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.
 
We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

As a Constellation Modeling and Simulations Architect, you will be a critical member of the Autonomous Flight Systems and Simulations Team building highly accurate models of the spacecraft and space environments. You will enjoy large complex problems with multi-agent contributions to determine specific and probabilistic results. Your background will include either a first principles understanding of spacecraft guidance navigation and control mechanisms and forces, or radio frequency engineering and modeling.
 

Why E-Space is right for you:

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core
• Fair and honest workplace
• Innovative thinking is encouraged
• Competitive salaries
• Continuous learning and development
• Health and wellness care options
• Financial solutions for the future

description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Зараз ми в пошуку Junior HR Admin (Кадровий облік), який/яка стане надійною опорою для бізнесу й команди, відповідатиме за кадрову документацію та процеси.

Які виклики чекають на тебе в ролі:

- Допомагати в організації та веденні кадрового документообігу на різних етапах життєвого циклу працівника: прийняття, переведення, зміна умов праці, звільнення, відрядження тощо.

- Готувати довідки, супровідні листи та інші кадрові документи за встановленими процесами.

- Формувати та підтримувати в актуальному стані особові справи працівників.

- Вносити та актуалізувати кадрову інформацію в HR-системах.

- Допомагати у підготовці кадрової звітності та внутрішніх звітів.

- Працювати з документами та даними, перевіряти їхню коректність і повноту.

- Допомагати в адмініструванні внутрішніх HR-процесів і підтримувати їхнє вдосконалення.

- Брати участь у веденні військового обліку під супроводом більш досвідченого колеги.

- Взаємодіяти з HR, Finance та іншими командами з питань кадрового адміністрування.

ІНСТРУМЕНТИ, З ЯКИМИ ТИ ПРАЦЮВАТИМЕШ:

- Excel / Google Sheets;

- PeopleForce, HiBob, 1С, BAS;

- внутрішні HR-системи та інструменти для роботи з документами.

Що для нас важливо:

- Від 1 року досвіду в кадровому адмініструванні / HR Administration / HR Operations або суміжній сфері.

- Розуміння трудового законодавства України та бажання поглиблювати свої знання.

- Уважність до деталей і відповідальність у роботі з документами та даними.

- Вміння працювати системно та дотримуватися встановлених процесів.

- Впевнене користування Excel або Google Sheets.

- Готовність працювати з великим обсягом інформації та документів.

- Бажання навчатися, розвиватися в HR Administration та поступово брати більше відповідальності.

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи з PeopleForce, HiBob, 1С, BAS або іншими HR-системами.

- Базове розуміння процесів військового обліку.

- Досвід участі в автоматизації або вдосконаленні HR-процесів.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт син

Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
POSITION PURPOSE
The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely, and complete processing, reconciliation, and reporting of accounts receivable activity. The role independently manages key receivable processes, resolves complex payment and account issues, supports the monthly close, and serves as a knowledgeable resource for internal and external stakeholders on accounts receivable matters. The position also supports continuous improvement of AR processes, systems, controls, and documentation to improve accuracy, efficiency, and the member experience.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage day-to-day accounts receivable activities, including the transfer, posting, and reconciliation of member invoices and payment data across Salesforce, Certinia, Cvent, and related systems.

• Research and resolve unidentified or misapplied payments, including wires, ACH payments, checks, and credit card transactions.

• Manage accounts receivable activity related to Lifetime Dues, including installment monitoring, delinquency follow-up, account reconciliation, and membership conversions.

• Respond to and resolve AR-related inquiries from members and internal stakeholders through Salesforce Service Console, email, and other communication channels.

• Review and process member refunds in coordination with Accounts Payable and in accordance with established policies and approval requirements.

• Perform monthly accounts receivable close activities, including reconciliation of AR aging to the general ledger, preparation of supporting schedules, and investigation of variances.

• Monitor past-due accounts and perform collection follow-up in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.

• Research and resolve member credit card disputes and payment-related issues.

• Partner with General Ledger and Accounts Payable teams on bank reconciliation items, refund activity, and other transactions impacting accounts receivable.

• Prepare and process miscellaneous invoices and ensure appropriate supporting documentation and accounting treatment.

• Coordinate the annual membership renewal billing process, including system testing, invoicing accuracy, and product configuration in Salesforce.

• Prepare and post journal entries related to accounts receivable activity.

• Identify opportunities to improve AR processes, documentation, controls, and system workflows, and assist with implementing approved improvements.

• Support annual audit requirements and prepare documentation and responses for AR-related audit requests.

• Work with IT and Finance partners to research and resolve system issues affecting receivable transactions and financial data integrity.

• Support Finance leadership with special projects, analysis, and other AR-related initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with YPO financial policies, procedures, accounting requirements, and internal controls.

SKILLS

• Strong working knowledge of accounts receivable processes and related accounting concepts.

• Ability to independently manage assigned AR responsibilities and follow issues through resolution.

• Strong reconciliation and analytical skills, including the ability to research and resolve complex payment, billing, and account discrepancies.

• High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and commitment to appropriate controls and documentation.

• Strong systems aptitude and ability to work effectively across ERP, CRM, event registration, and payment platforms.

• Ability to identify process issues and recommend practical improvements.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and deadlines.

• Sound judgment and ability to determine when issues can be resolved independently and when escalation is appropriate.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with members, associates, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Feature Ideation, Definition, and Development

title: Senior Manager Compute Solutions Architecture
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
You will lead Compute Solutions Architecture for Latitude: the team, the technical win rate, and the architectural standard we hold ourselves to. You will also stay personally in the deals.
This is a player-coach role, and we mean it literally. You will lead a team of Solutions Architects and hire more as the business earns them - and you will still be in front of customers every week, running discovery, sizing clusters, whiteboarding, scoping proofs of concept, and closing technical objections yourself. Latitude is a small, fast business inside a public company. There is no bench to hand work to. Expect roughly half your time leading and building the function, and half carrying architecture personally on the deals that decide the quarter.
Based in San Francisco, you will sit alongside our new Compute Sales Specialist and Account Manager, close to the AI-native and platform companies that are our fastest-growing customer segment - and you will lead a team that is globally distributed.
The mission is bigger than the Latitude number. Megaport acquired Latitude to combine compute and connectivity into a single offer. You are the technical leader who makes that combination sellable - to Latitude's inbound and founder-led motion, to Megaport's global field Sales Pods, and through Megaport's partner channel. This role is compute-first, with network design supported in partnership with Megaport's network Solution Architects.

title: Principal Engineer, Model Development Platform
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Model Development Platform team builds the infrastructure and tooling behind Wayve's AI model lifecycle, from data ingestion and training to experiment scheduling and on-road testing. Our work spans AI research, large-scale distributed systems and robotic operations, and lets researchers and engineers iterate fast and deploy autonomous driving models safely.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As Principal Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end architecture of the platform and keep it reliable, scalable and coherent. You'll partner with the Head of Model Dev Platform to set and execute the technical vision, aligning infrastructure and tooling with company goals. You'll lead by example, going deep across web applications, distributed compute, ML Ops, data pipelines and optimisation algorithms, and through architecture and mentorship you'll help teams build platform capabilities that measurably speed up model development and fleet learning.

🧩 What you'll be working on

- System architecture and reliability: designing and evolving the platform's architecture for reliability, observability and scalability, setting performance, latency and availability targets, and driving the engineering standards to meet them

- Cross-domain technical leadership: unifying the platform across front-end UIs, distributed training, Spark data pipelines and optimisation-based experiment scheduling, so systems work together cleanly

- Hands-on problem solving: taking on the hardest problems across subteams, leading architectural reviews and proposing pragmatic solutions that balance innovation with operational simplicity

- Experimentation and scheduling systems: building systems that optimise how models are tested in simulation and on-road, using techniques like linear programming and heuristic optimisation to balance hardware, safety and research priorities while improving throughput and turnaround

- Data and compute infrastructure: architecting pipelines that ingest, transform and enrich petabytes of fleet sensor data, and driving efficient compute use across GPU, CPU, cloud and edge for prototyping and large-scale training

- Strategic collaboration: working with Product, Research and Operations to align architecture with user needs, and co-owning the platform's long-term roadmap

🙌 You should apply if

- You have 10+ years designing and building large-scale distributed systems, ML/AI infrastructure, full-stack web applications or developer platforms, including at least 3 years as a staff or principal-level engineer

- You have designed systems spanning web platforms, ML pipelines and large-scale compute orchestration (e.g. Spark, Ray, Kubernetes, Airflow, MLflow)

- You have driven platform reliability improvements, defined SLAs/SLOs, and built self-healing, observable systems that run at "four nines" availability or better

- You understand distributed computing, workflow orchestration, data modelling and API design in depth, and can write and review production-quality code

- You communicate well across functions and can guide engineers, managers and researchers toward a unified technical direction

- You have mentored engineers across levels and built a culture of engineering excellence

Nice to have:

- Experience applying algorithmic or mathematical optimisation (e.g. linear programming, graph algorithms) to operational or scheduling problems

- Familiarity with end-to-end model lifecycle tooling, from data ingestion and training CI to model artifact tracking and evaluation workflows

- Prior exposure to autonomous systems, robotics or other safety-critical domains

- Experience with modern web frame

title: Inventory Processing Specialist
description:
Inventory Processing Specialist - Quality Control
Founded in 2017, REPS & Co. has rapidly become a leader in data analytics in the entertainment industry. Recognized on the Forbes list of America's Best Startup Employers, we focus on delivering advanced analytics that supports data driven decisions. Our solutions provide comprehensive insights and forecasts, enabling us to have a better understanding and response to supply and demand in the ticketing world. With a commitment to driving innovation, REPS & Co. helps shape a dynamic market environment.
We’re excited to add an Inventory Processing Specialist to our Quality Control team.
In this role, you’ll help ensure our ticket inventory is accurate, valid, and ready for sale. You’ll review purchases and listings, verify important ticket details, identify and correct discrepancies, and work closely with internal teams to maintain accurate inventory.
This position is ideal for someone who isdetail-oriented, comfortable with technology, quick to learn new systems, and able to work accurately in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do

• Learn and become proficient in company-specific processes, software, and systems.

• Review and approve inventory to ensure tickets are accurate and cleared for sale.

• Audit ticket purchases for accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

• Attach ticket PDFs and supporting documentation to listings in our POS system.

• Add required disclosures and restrictions to ticket listings so customers receive accurate information.

• Collaborate with internal brokers and team members to verify ticket purchases and inventory details.

• Research, track, and document orders that were not entered into the POS system and accurately enter missing orders.

• Track and process refund-related information.

• Purchase tickets as needed, representing up to approximately 10% of the role.

• Assist with additional Quality Control and inventory-related responsibilities as needed.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

• Comfortable working with technology and able to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes.

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.

• Fast and accurate data-entry skills; previous data-entry experience is a plus.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Dependable, punctual, and able to consistently meet responsibilities and deadlines.

• Collaborative team player who communicates constructively, listens actively, and willingly shares information.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, demands, and timelines.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with the initiative to identify and complete tasks without constant direction.

• Willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities as business needs evolve.

• Ability and willingness to work rotating shifts as required.

What Success Looks Like
You’ll be successful in this role if you consistently maintain accurate inventory, catch discrepancies before they affect customers, learn new processes quickly, and communicate effectively with your team. You’ll play an important part in making sure customers receive accurate ticket information and that our inventory is ready for sale.

Testing & Delivery
